hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.js) node --check "$f" >/dev/null 2>/tmp/err.txt || { echo "Error de sintaxis en $f:" >&2; head -5 /tmp/err.txt >&2; exit 2; } ;; *.gs) cp "$f" /tmp/revisar_gs.js && node --check /tmp/revisar_gs.js >/dev/null 2>/tmp/err.txt || { echo "Error de sintaxis en $f:" >&2; head -5 /tmp/err.txt >&2; exit 2; } ;; *.json) jq empty "$f" 2>/tmp/err.txt || { echo "JSON mal formado en $f:" >&2; cat /tmp/err.txt >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac; exit 0
